carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient with highlights on the superior edge and deep shadows on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, elongated reddish-brown mark or lesion is visible on the mid-lateral flank, positioned between the first and second horizontal spot rows.
